svg.title: Distributed credit map for the Greek Olympic baseball project
svg.desc: A role matrix assigning documented lanes to Greek organizers, diaspora volunteers, Nicholas Burns and Embassy Athens, political connectors, Peter Angelos and the Orioles, MLB International, Rob Derksen, and players.
svg.text: CREDIT MAP 01 · NOT A HERO DIAGRAM
Different actors carried different baseball burdens.
Documented lanes in the Greece project

g.text: GREEK ORGANIZERS / FEDERATION
Local initiative · federation · Greek legitimacy · leagues · Olympic responsibility
The project was not an American invention.
SAMIOTES / GALATIS / DIASPORA
Grassroots teaching · equipment · field-building · recruitment · volunteer labor
Their lane began before some later institutional chronologies.
BURNS / EMBASSY ATHENS
Convening · introductions · public demonstrations · budget advocacy · visibility
Connector, not team architect.
SARBANES / ANGELOS / ORIOLES
Diaspora-political link · ownership resources · organizational and recruiting support
Exact timing of every introduction remains uneven across sources.
MLB INTERNATIONAL
Coaches · development infrastructure · full-time baseball support in Athens
Keep this lane distinct from the still-unresolved Red Sox club contribution.
ROB DERKSEN / BASEBALL STAFF
Scouting · player evaluation · roster-building · coaching · competitive baseball
The operational hinge; Burns could not perform this work.
PLAYERS · LOCAL + DIASPORA
They made the national team real. The roster also made visible the tension between Olympic competitiveness and domestic development.

svg.text: A role map, not a causal ranking. No box is a claim of sole ownership.
